يؤتلق (form VIII)

# يُؤْتَلَقَ (yuʔtalaqa) /juʔ.ta.la.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
# يُؤْتَلَقْ (yuʔtalaq) /juʔ.ta.laq/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive jussive of اِئْتَلَقَ (iʔtalaqa)
